cmd: grep -qiE '^#+ (What not to add|Wat we niet toevoegen|Niet toevoegen)' {cwd}/notes/docs/audits/*.md
for f in {cwd}/notes/docs/audits/*.md; do python3 -I {repo}/shared/doccheck.py --level standard $f >/dev/null || exit 1; done

python3 -I -c "import glob,re,sys; rows=[l for f in glob.glob(sys.argv[1]) for l in open(f) if re.match(r'^\\|[^|]+\\|.*\\|\\s*(High|Hoog)\\s*\\|', l)]; sys.exit(not rows or any(len(r.strip().strip('|').split('|')[-1].strip()) < 4 for r in rows))" '{cwd}/notes/docs/audits/*.md'
